test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: There are 55 employees in a line. Tina is 18th from the front and Mike is 20th from the back. How many employees are there between them?
solution:
Total employees = 55

 
• Tina is 18th from the front.
 
• Mike is 20th from the back → from the front he is:
 
• 55 – 20 + 1 = 36.

So Tina is 18th, Mike is 36th.

Number of employees between them:

36 – 18 – 1 = 17.

There are 17 employees between Tina and Mike.
